payload.posture: Read Ezra 1:1–4 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the LORD stirs Cyrus to issue a written proclamation that credits the God of heaven with the kingdoms of the earth and authorizes a house in Jerusalem. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
